appDescription: A driving companion app where a pet character grows as the driver drives safely, with safety scores and driving missions.

function.name: GET_DRIVE_SCORE
function.description: Gets the safety score and the counts of risky driving events from the driver's most recent completed drive.

function.name: GET_PET_STATUS
function.description: Gets the name, growth stage, experience needed for the next stage, and points of the driver's pet character.

function.name: GET_MISSION_PROGRESS
function.description: Gets the driving missions the driver is currently challenging and the progress of each mission.
